text_block_list.text:
The three years spent etching the "now" 
with Mejiro Ardan had finally come to an 
end—

She left behind a brilliant trail of light 
in the Twinkle Series, one that will 
surely be recounted for ages to come.

Yet her history is far from over. The path 
she runs alongside her rivals will 
continue on into the future—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —Ooooooohh!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: —Yaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAAHH!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —Haa, haa, haa.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Both of your runs have become 
even sharper, haven't they?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Aaargh! I misjudged when to make my move! 
Next time won't go like this!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I agree. I may have yielded this time, but 
next time, you will both be chasing my 
back.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
No, the only thing Yaeno-san will see is 
my back!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: No, my—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Fufu...—
choice_data_list:
Everyone's working hard together, aren't 
they?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, it's already time 
for our meeting, isn't it? Excuse me."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Ardan-san, you're heading out? Good 
work today!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I will not let you get away with winning 
and running off. We shall settle this 
another day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, as many times as needed... I'll be in 
your care.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Well then, excuse us. —Shall we get going, 
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
――Being able to push each other like that 
"now," the three of us together with 
Chiyono O-san and Yaeno-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
This is also because you, Trainer, built 
up my "present" and connected our "future" 
to the two of them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Once again... I am truly grateful.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
choice_data_list:
I'll keep doing my best so we can paint 
our "future" together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Lately, I've finally been able to... look 
beyond the "present" and see the "future."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Continuously striving and pushing each 
other to greater heights alongside Chiyono 
O-san and Yaeno-san...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: By my side... is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: You are there for me, unchanging as ever.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...That's the kind of "future" it is.
